headline: Clean Energy Expands Fueling Network as Trucking and Refuse Fleets Across Canada Choose Natural Gas
summary: NEWPORT BEACH, Calif., August 04, 2026--Clean Energy Fuels Corp. (NASDAQ: CLNE), North America’s largest provider of renewable natural gas (RNG), the cleanest fuel for the transportation market, has announced a series of new fueling and maintenance agreements across Western Canada as fleets continue to turn to natural gas to reduce emissions and lower operating costs.
